summary: DRA_LONG_TREND_ENTRY_ADMISSION_BRANCH_CLOSE. The exact 52,608-row pre-2025 sealed corpus, frozen DRA V1 parent checkpoints, decision-time feature accounting and hard-inception rules passed. The prior-200-complete-day long-trend admission veto completely avoided 2022 losses, but this isolated benefit did not generalize: Design total PnL fell from 90.77797326 to 89.65425059 USDT, historical Validation total PnL fell from 86.20298186 to 80.57877745 USDT, Validation drawdown rose slightly from 7.121498% to 7.130542%, and completed holding distributions worsened in both windows. Annual total-PnL breadth was 1/5, realized-PnL breadth was 0/5, drawdown breadth was 3/5, and the only positive annual delta contributed 100% of positive uplift. This post-hoc long-trend admission family is closed with no neighboring trend horizon, rescue variant, alpha claim, strategy candidate or OOS access.
